title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: Lamb shoulder braised with warm spices, apricots and dates until it falls apart. Optional cast iron sear, then a long, gentle cook in the bowl.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Not yet cooked; the 90-minute braise is an estimate for 3cm shoulder pieces, so check at 75 minutes.

items.item: couscous, toasted flaked almonds and fresh coriander

steps.title: Sear (optional)
steps.text: Pat the lamb ({{lamb}}) very dry. Sear hard in the cast iron with the oil ({{sear-oil}}), in two batches, about 2 minutes a side. Do not crowd the pan. Skip this if short on time; the spices carry the dish without it.

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Add the onion ({{onion}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) and ginger ({{ginger}}) to the bowl. Chop 5 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Add the olive oil ({{oil}}). Sauté 3 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

steps.title: Bloom the spices
steps.text: Add the cumin ({{cumin}}), ground coriander ({{ground-coriander}}), cinnamon ({{cinnamon}}), paprika ({{paprika}}), turmeric ({{turmeric}}) and tomato paste ({{tomato-paste}}). Cook 1 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Add the lamb and any resting juices, the tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), stock ({{stock}}), honey ({{honey}}) and salt ({{salt}}). Cook 60 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir, MC off with the simmering basket on the lid.

steps.title: Add the fruit
steps.text: Add the apricots ({{apricots}}) and dates ({{dates}}). Cook 30 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir, same lid setup, until the lamb gives way under a fork.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest 10 minutes off the heat, uncovered, so the sauce thickens. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over couscous, scattered with toasted almonds and coriander.

notes.title: Capacity
notes.text: These amounts land around 1.8L. Do not scale past 4 serves in the bowl.

notes.title: Cut
notes.text: Shoulder only. Leg is too lean for a braise this long and goes dry.

notes.title: Couscous
notes.text: Pour equal volumes of boiling stock over couscous, cover and leave 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and a knob of butter.

notes.title: Chickpeas
notes.text: A drained 400g tin of chickpeas can go in with the fruit to stretch it to 5 or 6 serves, but check the bowl stays below the 2.2L line.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: Better the next day. 3 days in the fridge, 3 months in the freezer.
